cases.title: With the two Undo switches on, CD's [Undo] at the third route point says Undid: point 3 of the pipe route, Esc then cancels with nothing drawn, and U after PIT and after MOVE echoes PIT and MOVE
cases.plan_item: UX-UNDO-01 (daily card D19), switch-on setting only
cases.expected: CD with points 150000,-85000, 160000,-85000 and 165000,-87000, then U at the [Undo] prompt, prints 'Undid: point 3 of the pipe route.'; Esc prints '[CE] CD command cancelled.', no New Pipe window opens and the object count is unchanged. PIT at 150000,-88000 (cover 19.000, Esc at label, cover and next pit) places a pit; one U echoes PIT. MOVE of pit P3 by 0,2000 says '1 found' and moves it to Y -23569.8; one U echoes MOVE and puts it back at Y -25569.8.
cases.why_not_unit: AutoCAD's own undo echo and the live CD prompt keyword are only visible in a running session, and the switches are read from the real settings file at start-up.
not_automated: The settings switches are OFF in Tim's file: this case does NOT prove what a colleague with Tim's switches gets (the plain U echoes are proved in R12, R13 and N01 to N02 for MOVE, CDSYNC, CDREBUILD and EXPLODE).
REDO after each U is not driven here (BUG-861 family; R08).

REDO after the U is not driven (BUG-861 family; R08).
